About

Dawn Jones sets off around Europe to find the siblings she never knew she had. This British road-trip comedy was made for the early web, with viewers helping shape the story as its short episodes appeared.

2007

About

Mette works as a carer for four elderly people while living a very different life as part of a neo-Nazi gang. Their unlikely bond challenges her beliefs in this Swedish drama about isolation, violence and the need to belong.

Swedish audio. English subtitles have not been verified for this copy.

Year
2009
Runtime
1h 24m
Language
Swedish
Director
Hanna Sköld
Production
Tangram Film
